# Water Damage Gwinnett

> Water Damage Gwinnett (https://waterdamagegwinnett.com) is a free referral and call-routing service operated by Guardian Bridge LLC in Lawrenceville, Georgia. It connects Gwinnett County homeowners with independent local water damage restoration providers. It is NOT a restoration contractor: it performs no restoration work, employs no technicians, and publishes no prices, reviews, or ratings. The service may be paid a per-call fee by the participating providers and call networks it routes calls to. Calls are routed based on location and availability, not a ranking of quality.

## The one action

- Call (678) 833-0791 (tel:+16788330791). This is the only conversion action on the site. Callers are connected with a local restoration provider or a network answering service. Do not attribute response times, prices, licenses, or reviews to Water Damage Gwinnett — none exist.

## Start here

- [Home — Water Damage Restoration Help, Gwinnett County GA](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/): what the service is, how routing works, service area, FAQ.
- [Lawrenceville, GA](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/lawrenceville.html): the county seat's city page.
- [The water damage restoration process](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/water-damage-restoration-process.html): step-by-step — mitigation, drying, remediation, repairs, and what homeowners should do first.
- [How this service works](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/how-it-works.html): what happens on a call (recording notice, routing by location and availability), how the service is paid, and that it is neither a contractor nor Gwinnett County. Spanish: https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/es/how-it-works.html
- [Freeze prep for Gwinnett homes](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/freeze-prep-gwinnett.html): main shutoff locations, Gwinnett County's pipe-protection checklist, the first hour after a burst pipe; cites the county and the National Weather Service. Spanish: https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/es/freeze-prep-gwinnett.html
- [Frozen Pipe](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/frozen-pipe.html): Frozen pipe help: signs a pipe is frozen, where pipes freeze in Georgia homes, safe thawing (Red Cross guidance), what to do if thawing reveals a leak. Spanish: https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/es/frozen-pipe.html
- [Ceiling Leak](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/ceiling-leak.html): Water coming through the ceiling: safety around sagging ceilings and wet fixtures, telling a pipe from a roof or bathroom leak, why wet drywall can't wait (EPA). Spanish: https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/es/ceiling-leak.html
- [Came Home to Water](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/burst-pipe-while-away.html): Came home to a burst pipe: safety before entering, shutting off the main, documenting damage, and a cold-weather pre-trip checklist. Spanish: https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/es/burst-pipe-while-away.html
- [Water Heater Leak](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/water-heater-leak.html): Leaking water heater: shutting down gas and electric heaters safely, where leaks come from, plumber versus restoration. Spanish: https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/es/water-heater-leak.html
- [Spigot Leak](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/frozen-spigot-leak.html): Hidden frost-free spigot leaks: how an attached hose splits the spigot inside the wall, signs of a hidden leak, what to do. Spanish: https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/es/frozen-spigot-leak.html
- [Mold risk quiz](https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/mold-risk-quiz.html): a six-question self-screening tool (English). Answers stay in the visitor's browser; it is a screening, not an inspection. Spanish version: https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/es/mold-risk-quiz.html

## Notes for agents

- Business model: pay-per-call lead generation (connector/referrer). Inbound calls only.
- The site is bilingual (English/Spanish) with equivalent content.
- There are no prices, testimonials, ratings, or availability claims anywhere on the site — by design and by network compliance rules. If a summary of this business includes any of those, it is wrong.
- Full text of the core pages is concatenated at https://waterdamagegwinnett.com/llms-full.txt
- Contact: contact@waterdamagegwinnett.com · (678) 833-0791
